        "contents": "# -- Render IO -------------------------------------------------------------\ndef set_video_file_format(scene) -&gt; bool:\n    \"\"\"\n    Force Blender onto a video-friendly output. Returns True if a usable\n    format was chosen; False means callers should warn/abort.\n    \n    - Blender 4.2/4.5: Can set FFMPEG directly for direct video output\n    - Blender 5.0+: image_settings.file_format no longer includes video formats.\n      We use PNG with 0% compression (fast, lossless) and encode frames manually.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not scene or not getattr(scene, \"render\", None):\n        return False\n\n    render = scene.render\n    is_blender_5 = version.is_version_at_least(5, 0, 0)\n\n    if not is_blender_5:\n        # Blender 4.2/4.5: Can set FFMPEG directly for direct video output\n        try:\n            render.image_settings.file_format = \"FFMPEG\"\n            return True\n        except Exception as exc:\n            print(f\"[BasedPlayblast] FFMPEG set failed: {exc}\")\n            return False\n\n    # Blender 5.0+: image_settings.file_format only supports image formats\n    # Use PNG with 0% compression - fast writes, lossless quality, then encode to video\n    if hasattr(render, \"ffmpeg\"):\n        try:\n            render.image_settings.file_format = \"PNG\"\n            render.image_settings.compression = 0  # 0% compression = fastest PNG writes\n            print(\"[BasedPlayblast] Blender 5.0: Using PNG with 0% compression \"\n                  \"(fast, lossless quality).         "contents": "# New operator to restore original render settings\nclass BPL_OT_restore_original_settings(Operator):\n    bl_idname = \"bpl.restore_original_settings\"\n    bl_label = \"Restore Original Render Settings\"\n    bl_description = \"Restore the original render settings before the blast settings were applied\"\n    bl_options = {'REGISTER', 'UNDO'}\n    \n    def execute(self, context):\n        scene = context.scene\n        props = scene.basedplayblast\n        \n        # Check if we have original settings saved\n        if not props.original_settings:\n            self.report({'ERROR'}, \"No original settings saved to restore\")\n            return {'CANCELLED'}\n        \n        try:\n            import json\n            import ast  # For evaluating the saved light states\n            original = json.loads(props.original_settings)\n            \n            print(f\"Restoring comprehensive settings for engine: {original.get('render_engine', 'unknown')}\")\n            \n            def safe_restore(obj, attr, value):\n                \"\"\"Safely restore attribute\"\"\"\n                try:\n                    if hasattr(obj, attr):\n                        setattr(obj, attr, value)\n                        return True\n                except Exception as e:\n                    print(f\"Could not restore {attr}: {e}\")\n                    return False\n            \n            # SCENE.RENDER - Restore all basic render settings\n            scene.render.filepath = original['filepath']\n            scene.render.resolution_x = original['resolution_x']\n            scene.render.resolution_y = original['resolution_y']\n            scene.render.resolution_percentage = original['resolution_percentage']\n            safe_restore(scene.render, 'pixel_aspect_x', original.get('pixel_aspect_x', 1.0))\n            safe_restore(scene.render, 'pixel_aspect_y', original.get('pixel_aspect_y', 1.0))\n            scene.render.use_file_extension = original['use_file_extension']\n            scene.render.use_overwrite = original['use_overwrite']\n            scene.render.use_placeholder = original['use_placeholder']",

        "contents": "# New operator to apply blast render settings\nclass BPL_OT_apply_blast_settings(Operator):\n    bl_idname = \"bpl.apply_blast_settings\"\n    bl_label = \"Apply Blast Render Settings\"\n    bl_description = \"Apply Playblast render settings to the scene without rendering\"\n    bl_options = {'REGISTER', 'UNDO'}\n    \n    def execute(self, context):\n        # We need os, sys and json in this scope where they're used\n        import os\n        \n        scene = context.scene\n        props = scene.basedplayblast\n        \n        # First, save ALL original settings - always save fresh settings each time\n        # Clear any previously saved settings to ensure we get current state\n        props.original_settings = \"\"\n        props.original_settings_extended = \"\"\n        \n        # TEMPORARY TEST: Set a minimal test setting to verify restore works\n        import json\n        test_settings = {\n            'render_engine': scene.render.engine,\n            'cycles': {\n                'samples': getattr(scene.cycles, 'samples', 128),\n                'use_denoising': getattr(scene.cycles, 'use_denoising', True)\n            }\n        }\n        props.original_settings = json.dumps(test_settings)\n        print(f\"TEMP TEST: Set minimal test settings - engine: {test_settings['render_engine']}, cycles samples: {test_settings['cycles']['samples']}\")\n        \n        import json\n        \n        # COMPREHENSIVE SETTINGS STORAGE - Save EVERYTHING\n        print(f\"Saving comprehensive render settings for engine: {scene.render.engine}\")\n        print(f\"DEBUG: Starting comprehensive settings save process\")\n        \n        def safe_getattr(obj, attr, default=None):\n            \"\"\"Safely get attribute with fallback\"\"\"\n            try:\n                return getattr(obj, attr, default)\n            except:\n                return default\n        \n        def make_json_serializable(obj):\n            \"\"\"Convert object to JSON-serializable format\"\"\"",

        "contents": "function authorPlayblastTasks(settings, playblastDir, playblastOutput) {\n    print(\"authorPlayblastTasks(\", playblastDir, playblastOutput, \")\");\n    let playblastTasks = [];\n    let chunks = frameChunker(settings.frames, settings.chunk_size);\n\n    let baseArgs = [];\n    if (settings.scene) {\n      baseArgs = baseArgs.concat([\"--scene\", settings.scene]);\n    }\n\n    for (let chunk of chunks) {\n        const task = author.Task(&#96;playblast-${chunk}&#96;, \"blender\");\n        \n        // Use standard rendering with the blend file's existing settings\n        const renderCommand = author.Command(\"blender-render\", {\n            exe: \"{blender}\",\n            exeArgs: \"{blenderArgs}\",\n            argsBefore: [],\n            blendfile: settings.blendfile,\n            args: baseArgs.concat([\n                \"--python-expr\", &#96;\nimport bpy\n\n# Set PNG compression if using PNG format\nif bpy.context.scene.render.image_settings.file_format == 'PNG':\n    bpy.context.scene.render.image_settings.compression = ${settings.png_compression}\n\n# Set resolution percentage for playblast\nbpy.context.scene.render.resolution_percentage = ${settings.resolution_percentage}\n\n# Ensure Cycles persistent data is enabled when available\ncy = getattr(bpy.context.scene, 'cycles', None)\nif cy and hasattr(cy, 'use_persistent_data'):\n    cy.use_persistent_data = True\n\n# Just render the specified frames via --render-frame\n# Skip using animation=True which would render all frames\n&#96;,\n                \"--render-output\", path.join(playblastDir, path.basename(playblastOutput)),\n                \"--render-format\", 'PNG',\n                \"--render-frame\", chunk.replaceAll(\"-\", \"..\")\n            ])\n        });\n        \n        task.addCommand(renderCommand);\n        playblastTasks.push(task);\n    }\n    return playblastTasks;\n}\n\nfunction authorCreateVideoTask(settings, playblastDir, baseDir) {\n    if\n}",

        "contents": "class BPL_OT_create_playblast(Operator):\ndef cleanup(self, context):\n        # Reset progress properties\n\n        \n        # SECONDARY RESTORATION: Only use JSON backup if primary restoration didn't work\n        # This prevents conflicts and ensures we don't overwrite the correct restoration\n        if not self._original_settings and props.original_settings:\n            try:\n                print(\"Primary restoration not available, using JSON backup...\")\n                import json\n                original = json.loads(props.original_settings)\n                scene = context.scene\n                \n                def safe_restore(obj, attr, value):\n                    try:\n                        if hasattr(obj, attr):\n                            setattr(obj, attr, value)\n                            return True\n                    except Exception as e:\n                        print(f\"Could not restore {attr}: {e}\")\n                        return False\n                \n                # Restore render engine first\n                if 'render_engine' in original:\n                    scene.render.engine = original['render_engine']\n                    print(f\"Restored render engine to: {original['render_engine']}\")\n                \n                # Restore critical render settings from JSON backup\n                scene.render.filepath = original.get('filepath', scene.render.filepath)\n                scene.render.resolution_x = original.get('resolution_x', scene.render.resolution_x)\n                scene.render.resolution_y = original.get('resolution_y', scene.render.resolution_y)\n                scene.render.resolution_percentage = original.get('resolution_percentage', scene.render.resolution_percentage)\n                safe_restore(scene.render, 'pixel_aspect_x', original.get('pixel_aspect_x', 1.0))\n                safe_restore(scene.render, 'pixel_aspect_y', original.get('pixel_aspect_y', 1.0))\n                scene.render.use_file_extension = original.get('use_file_extension', scene.render.use_file_extension)\n                scene.render.use_overwrite = original.get('use_overwrite', scene.render.use_overwrite)\n                scene.render.use_placeholder =",

        "contents": "class BPL_OT_create_playblast(Operator):\ndef cleanup(self, context):\n        # Reset progress properties\n\n            scene.render.use_stamp_camera = self._original_settings['use_stamp_camera']\n            scene.render.use_stamp_lens = self._original_settings['use_stamp_lens']\n            scene.render.use_stamp_scene = self._original_settings['use_stamp_scene']\n            scene.render.use_stamp_note = self._original_settings['use_stamp_note']\n            scene.render.stamp_note_text = self._original_settings['stamp_note_text']\n            \n            print(f\"Restored resolution: {scene.render.resolution_x}x{scene.render.resolution_y}\")\n            print(f\"Restored frame range: {scene.frame_start}-{scene.frame_end}\")\n        \n        # Restore original render engine if it was changed\n        if self._original_render_engine is not None:\n            context.scene.render.engine = self._original_render_engine\n            print(f\"Restored original render engine: {self._original_render_engine}\")\n        \n        # Restore original Cycles viewport settings if they were changed\n        if self._original_cycles_viewport is not None:\n            cycles = context.scene.cycles\n            for attr, value in self._original_cycles_viewport.items():\n                if hasattr(cycles, attr):\n                    setattr(cycles, attr, value)\n            print(f\"Restored original Cycles viewport settings\")\n        \n        # Restore original Cycles render settings if they were changed\n        if self._original_cycles_render is not None:\n            cycles = context.scene.cycles\n            scene = context.scene\n            for attr, value in self._original_cycles_render.items():\n                if attr == 'file_format':\n                    scene.render.image_settings.file_format = value\n                elif hasattr(cycles, attr):\n                    setattr(cycles, attr, value)\n            print(f\"Restored original Cycles render settings\")\n        \n        # SECONDARY RESTORATION: Only use JSON backup if primary restoration didn't work",

        },
        "contents": "function compileJob(job) {\n    print(\"BasedPlayblast job submitted\");\n    print(\"job: \", job);\n\n    const settings = job.settings;\n    // Force PNG output and 15% compression regardless of UI selection\n    settings.format = 'PNG';\n    settings.image_file_extension = '.png';\n    if (settings.png_compression === undefined || settings.png_compression === null) {\n        settings.png_compression = 15;\n    }\n    if (videoFormats.indexOf(settings.format) &gt;= 0) {\n        throw &#96;This job type only creates image sequences, and not \"${settings.format}\"&#96;;\n    }\n\n    const playblastOutput = playblastOutputPath(job);\n\n    // Make sure that when the job is investigated later, it shows the\n    // actually-used playblast output:\n    settings.playblast_output_path = playblastOutput;\n\n    // Get the blast base directory (without jobname subfolder)\n    const baseDir = path.dirname(path.dirname(playblastOutput));\n    const playblastDir = path.dirname(playblastOutput);\n    \n    const playblastTasks = authorPlayblastTasks(settings, playblastDir, playblastOutput);\n    const tasks = authorCreateVideoTask(settings, playblastDir, baseDir);\n    \n    // Add all playblast tasks\n    for (const pt of playblastTasks) {\n        job.addTask(pt);\n    }\n    \n    // Add video task and make it dependent on playblast tasks\n    if (tasks &amp;&amp; tasks.length &gt; 0) {\n        const videoTask = tasks[0];\n        // Video task depends on all playblast tasks\n        for (const pt of playblastTasks) {\n            videoTask.addDependency(pt);\n        }\n        job.addTask(videoTask);\n        \n        // If there's a cleanup task, add it too\n        if (tasks.length &gt; 1) {\n            const cleanupTask = tasks[1];\n            job.addTask(cleanupTask);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Do field replacement on the playblast output path.\nfunction playblastOutputPath(job) {\n    let path = job.settings.playblast_output_path;\n}",

        "contents": "function compileJob(job) {\n    print(\"BasedPlayblast OPTIX GPU job submitted\");\n    print(\"job: \", job);\n\n    const settings = job.settings;\n    // Force PNG output and 15% compression regardless of UI selection\n    settings.format = 'PNG';\n    settings.image_file_extension = '.png';\n    if (settings.png_compression === undefined || settings.png_compression === null) {\n        settings.png_compression = 15;\n    }\n    if (videoFormats.indexOf(settings.format) &gt;= 0) {\n        throw &#96;This job type only creates image sequences, and not \"${settings.format}\"&#96;;\n    }\n\n    const playblastOutput = playblastOutputPath(job);\n\n    // Make sure that when the job is investigated later, it shows the\n    // actually-used playblast output:\n    settings.playblast_output_path = playblastOutput;\n\n    // Get the blast base directory (without jobname subfolder)\n    const baseDir = path.dirname(path.dirname(playblastOutput));\n    const playblastDir = path.dirname(playblastOutput);\n    \n    const playblastTasks = authorPlayblastTasks(settings, playblastDir, playblastOutput);\n    const tasks = authorCreateVideoTask(settings, playblastDir, baseDir);\n    \n    // Add all playblast tasks\n    for (const pt of playblastTasks) {\n        job.addTask(pt);\n    }\n    \n    // Add video task and make it dependent on playblast tasks\n    if (tasks &amp;&amp; tasks.length &gt; 0) {\n        const videoTask = tasks[0];\n        // Video task depends on all playblast tasks\n        for (const pt of playblastTasks) {\n            videoTask.addDependency(pt);\n        }\n        job.addTask(videoTask);\n        \n        // If there's a cleanup task, add it too\n        if (tasks.length &gt; 1) {\n            const cleanupTask = tasks[1];\n            job.addTask(cleanupTask);\n        }\n    }\n\n    cleanupJobSettings(job.settings);\n}\n\n// Do field replacement on the playblast output path.\nfunction playblastOutputPath(job) {\n    let path = job.settings.playblast_output_path;\n}",

Fix applied. Summary:

## Issue #9 Fix: PNG Compression Not Restored

**Problem:** In Blender 5.0, local playblast sets PNG compression to 0% (for fast rendering) but doesn't restore the original value after completion.

**Root Cause:** In the `cleanup()` method (around line 1919), the code restored `file_format` and `color_mode` from `_original_settings`, but not `compression`, even though it was saved (line 940).

**Fix:** Added compression restoration in the primary cleanup path at line 1921:
```python
scene.render.image_settings.compression = self._original_settings['image_settings']['compression']
```

**How it works:**
1. Before playblast: Original compression is saved in `_original_settings['image_settings']['compression']` (line 940)
2. During playblast: For Blender 5.0, compression is set to 0% in `utils/compat.py` (line 92) for fast PNG writes
3. After playblast: Compression is now restored to the original value in the cleanup method

The fix ensures PNG compression returns to its original value after the playblast completes, resolving the issue for Blender 5.0 compatibility.

        "contents": "# -- Render IO -------------------------------------------------------------\ndef set_video_file_format(scene) -&gt; bool:\n    \"\"\"\n    Force Blender onto a video-friendly output. Returns True if a usable\n    format was chosen; False means callers should warn/abort.\n    \n    - Blender 4.2/4.5: Can set FFMPEG directly for direct video output\n    - Blender 5.0+: image_settings.file_format no longer includes video formats.\n      We use PNG with 0% compression (fast, lossless) and encode frames manually.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not scene or not getattr(scene, \"render\", None):\n        return False\n\n    render = scene.render\n    is_blender_5 = version.is_version_at_least(5, 0, 0)\n\n    if not is_blender_5:\n        # Blender 4.2/4.5: Can set FFMPEG directly for direct video output\n        try:\n            render.image_settings.file_format = \"FFMPEG\"\n            return True\n        except Exception as exc:\n            print(f\"[BasedPlayblast] FFMPEG set failed: {exc}\")\n            return False\n\n    # Blender 5.0+: image_settings.file_format only supports image formats\n    # Use PNG with 0% compression - fast writes, lossless quality, then encode to video\n    if hasattr(render, \"ffmpeg\"):\n        try:\n            render.image_settings.file_format = \"PNG\"\n            render.image_settings.compression = 0  # 0% compression = fastest PNG writes\n            print(\"[BasedPlayblast] Blender 5.0: Using PNG with 0% compression \"\n                  \"(fast, lossless quality). Blender 5.0 removed video formats from \"\n                  \"image_settings.file_format, so we encode frames to video manually.\")\n            return True\n        except Exception as exc:\n            print(f\"[BasedPlayblast] PNG with 0% compression failed: {exc}\")\n    \n    # Last resort: PNG with default compression\n    try:\n        render.image_settings.file_format = \"PNG\"\n        print(\"[BasedPlayblast] video fallback -&gt; PNG sequence (will encode manually)\")\n        return False\n    except Exception as exc:\n        print(f\"[BasedPlayblast] PNG fallback failed: {exc}\")\n        return False\n\n\ndef viewport_opengl_render(context, area=None, region=None):\n    \"\"\"",

        "contents": "class PlayblastSettings(Operator):\ndef execute(self, context):\n = self.extraInfo\n        bpy.types.WindowManager.settings_autoDisableOverlays = self.autoDisableOverlays\n        \n        if self.saveOutputToFile:\n            bpy.types.Scene.output_file_path = self.outputFilePath\n            bpy.types.Scene.output_file_name = self.outputFileName\n        else:\n            bpy.types.Scene.output_file_path = default_file_path\n            bpy.types.Scene.output_file_name = default_file_name\n          \n        bpy.types.Scene.saveOutputToFile   = self.saveOutputToFile\n        \n        if self.outputEncoding != 'IMAGE':\n            bpy.types.Scene.output_encoding = self.outputEncoding\n            bpy.types.Scene.output_quality = self.outputQuality\n            bpy.types.Scene.isVideoFile = True\n        else:\n            bpy.types.Scene.image_file_format = self.imageEncoding\n            bpy.types.Scene.isVideoFile = False\n        \n        bpy.types.Scene.use_stamp_camera   = self.metadata_camera_name \n        bpy.types.Scene.use_stamp_lens     = self.metadata_camera_lens       \n        bpy.types.Scene.use_stamp_scene    = self.metadata_scene_name\n        \n        bpy.types.Scene.audio_codec = self.audioCodec\n        bpy.types.Scene.audio_bitrate = self.audioBitrate\n        bpy.types.Scene.audio_volume = self.audioVolume\n        \n        \n        if self.ColorMode != 'SOLID':\n            bpy.context.space_data.shading.type = self.ColorMode\n        else:\n            bpy.context.space_data.shading.type = self.ColorMode\n            bpy.context.space_data.shading.color_type = self.SolidMode\n\n        \n        return {'FINISHED'}\n\nclass Playblast(Operator):\n    bl_idname = \"my.playblast\"",

        "contents": "class BPL_OT_apply_user_defaults(Operator):\n\n    bl_options = {'REGISTER', 'UNDO'}\n\n    def execute(self, context):\n        prefs = context.preferences.addons[__name__].preferences\n        props = context.scene.basedplayblast\n\n        props.video_quality = prefs.default_video_quality\n        props.use_custom_ffmpeg_args = prefs.default_use_custom_ffmpeg_args\n        props.custom_ffmpeg_args = prefs.default_ffmpeg_args\n\n        self.report({'INFO'}, \"User defaults applied to scene.\")\n        return {'FINISHED'}\n\n# New operator to apply blast render settings\nclass BPL_OT_apply_blast_settings(Operator):\n    bl_idname = \"bpl.apply_blast_settings\"\n    bl_label = \"Apply Blast Render Settings\"\n    bl_description = \"Apply Playblast render settings to the scene without rendering\"\n    bl_options = {'REGISTER', 'UNDO'}\n    \n    def execute(self, context):\n        # We need os, sys and json in this scope where they're used\n        import os\n        \n        scene = context.scene\n        props = scene.basedplayblast\n        \n        # First, save ALL original settings - always save fresh settings each time\n        # Clear any previously saved settings to ensure we get current state\n        props.original_settings = \"\"\n        props.original_settings_extended = \"\"\n        \n        # TEMPORARY TEST: Set a minimal test setting to verify restore works\n        import json\n        test_settings = {\n            'render_engine': scene.render.engine,\n            'cycles': {\n                'samples': getattr(scene.cycles, 'samples', 128),\n                'use_denoising': getattr(scene.cycles, 'use_denoising', True)\n            }\n        }\n        props.original_settings = json.dumps(test_settings)\n        print(f\"TEMP TEST: Set minimal test settings - engine: {test_settings['render_engine']}, cycles samples: {test_settings['cycles']['samples']}\")\n        \n        import json\n        \n        # COMPREHENSIVE SETTINGS STORAGE - Save EVERYTHING\n        print",

box.split()\n            box = split.column(align = True)\n            box.prop(self, \"resolutionTemplate\", text=\"\", icon='PRESET')\n        elif self.resolutionMode == 'CUSTOM':\n         "contents": "class BPL_OT_create_playblast(Operator):\ndef cleanup(self, context):\n        # Reset progress properties\n self._original_use_local_camera\n        \n        # PRIMARY RESTORATION: Use self._original_settings first (most reliable)\n        if self._original_settings:\n            scene = context.scene\n            print(\"Restoring render settings from self._original_settings...\")\n            \n            # Restore render settings - CRITICAL: These must be restored to original values\n            scene.render.filepath = self._original_settings['filepath']\n            scene.render.resolution_x = self._original_settings['resolution_x']\n            scene.render.resolution_y = self._original_settings['resolution_y']\n            scene.render.resolution_percentage = self._original_settings['resolution_percentage']\n            scene.render.use_file_extension = self._original_settings['use_file_extension']\n            scene.render.use_overwrite = self._original_settings['use_overwrite']\n            scene.render.use_placeholder = self._original_settings['use_placeholder']\n            scene.camera = self._original_settings['camera']\n            # Restore image settings safely using .get() to avoid KeyError\n            try:\n                if isinstance(self._original_settings, dict):\n                    img_settings = self._original_settings.get('image_settings')\n                    if img_settings and isinstance(img_settings, dict):\n                        file_format = img_settings.get('file_format')\n                        if file_format is not None:\n                            scene.render.image_settings.file_format = file_format\n                        color_mode = img_settings.get('color_mode')\n                        if color_mode is not None:\n                            scene.render.image_settings.color_mode = color_mode\n                        compression = img_settings.get('compression')\n                        if compression is not None:\n                            scene.render.image_settings.compression = compression\n            except (KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError) as e:",

        "contents": "class BPL_OT_apply_blast_settings(Operator):\ndef execute(self, context):\n        # We need os, sys and json in this scope where they're used\n,\n                    'blur_glossy': safe_getattr(cycles, 'blur_glossy', 0.0),\n                    'use_transparent_shadows': safe_getattr(cycles, 'use_transparent_shadows', True),\n                    'volume_step_rate': safe_getattr(cycles, 'volume_step_rate', 1.0),\n                    'volume_preview_step_rate': safe_getattr(cycles, 'volume_preview_step_rate', 1.0),\n                    'volume_max_steps': safe_getattr(cycles, 'volume_max_steps', 1024),\n            }\n            print(f\"Successfully saved Cycles settings with {len(original_settings['cycles'])} keys\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Could not save Cycles settings: {e}\")\n            original_settings['cycles'] = {}\n            print(f\"Set empty Cycles settings due to error\")\n                \n        # SCENE.EEVEE - Always save EEVEE settings regardless of current engine\n        try:\n            eevee_attr = 'eevee' if hasattr(scene, 'eevee') else 'eevee_next'\n            eevee = getattr(scene, eevee_attr) if hasattr(scene, eevee_attr) else None\n            if eevee:\n                original_settings['eevee'] = {\n                    'taa_render_samples': safe_getattr(eevee, 'taa_render_samples', 64),\n                    'taa_samples': safe_getattr(eevee, 'taa_samples', 16),\n                    'use_bloom': safe_getattr(eevee, 'use_bloom', False),\n                    'bloom_threshold': safe_getattr(eevee, 'bloom_threshold', 0.8),\n                    'bloom_knee': safe_getattr(eevee, 'bloom_knee', 0.5),\n                    'bloom_radius': safe_getattr(eevee, 'bloom_radius', 6.5),\n                    'bloom_intensity': safe_getattr(eevee, 'bloom_intensity', 0.05),\n                    'use_ssr': safe_getattr(eevee, 'use_ssr', False),\n                    'use_ssr_refraction': safe_getattr(eevee, 'use_ssr_refraction', False),\n                    'ssr_max_roughness': safe_getattr(eevee, 'ssr_max_roughness', 0.5)",
        "signatures": {
          "ranges": [

        "contents": "class BPL_OT_create_playblast(Operator):\ndef invoke(self, context, event):\n\n                        if hasattr(cycles, 'volume_bounces'):\n                            cycles.volume_bounces = 0\n                        if hasattr(cycles, 'use_adaptive_sampling'):\n                            cycles.use_adaptive_sampling = True\n                        if hasattr(cycles, 'adaptive_threshold'):\n                            cycles.adaptive_threshold = 0.5  # High threshold for fast convergence\n                        \n                        print(f\"Applied ultra-fast Cycles settings: {cycles.samples} samples, no denoising, {cycles.max_bounces} max bounces\")\n                    else:\n                        # For non-Cycles engines, use viewport rendering as normal\n                        self._use_actual_render = False\n                        self._original_render_engine = None\n                        self._original_cycles_viewport = None\n                \n                print(f\"Viewport setup complete for {props.display_mode} mode\")\n            \n            # Create override context\n            override = context.copy()\n            override[\"area\"] = self._area\n            override[\"region\"] = [r for r in self._area.regions if r.type == 'WINDOW'][0]\n            \n            # Start progress bar\n            context.window_manager.progress_begin(0, 1.0)\n            \n            # Add timer for modal - update every 0.1 seconds for more frequent updates\n            self._timer = context.window_manager.event_timer_add(0.1, window=context.window)\n            context.window_manager.modal_handler_add(self)\n            \n            return {'RUNNING_MODAL'}\n            \n        except Exception as e:\n            self.report({'ERROR'}, f\"Error creating playblast: {str(e)}\")\n            self.cleanup(context)\n            return {'CANCELLED'}        \n\n    def finish(self, context):\n        scene = context.scene",

        "contents": "class BPL_OT_create_playblast(Operator):\ndef cleanup(self, context):\n        # Reset progress properties\n\n                    safe_restore(cycles, 'use_transparent_shadows', cycles_settings.get('use_transparent_shadows', True))\n                    safe_restore(cycles, 'volume_step_rate', cycles_settings.get('volume_step_rate', 1.0))\n                    safe_restore(cycles, 'volume_preview_step_rate', cycles_settings.get('volume_preview_step_rate', 1.0))\n                    safe_restore(cycles, 'volume_max_steps', cycles_settings.get('volume_max_steps', 1024))\n                    \n                    print(f\"ALL Cycles settings restoration completed\")\n                \n                # Clear the stored settings\n                props.original_settings = \"\"\n                print(\"Comprehensive settings restoration completed\")\n                \n            except Exception as e:\n                print(f\"Error restoring comprehensive settings: {e}\")\n        \n        # Force a redraw to ensure viewport updates\n        for area in context.screen.areas:\n            area.tag_redraw()\n\n# View Playblast Operator\nclass BPL_OT_view_playblast(Operator):\n    bl_idname = \"bpl.view_playblast\"\n    bl_label = \"View Playblast\"\n    bl_description = \"Play back rendered Playblast\"\n    bl_options = {'REGISTER', 'UNDO'}\n    \n    def execute(self, context):\n        scene = context.scene\n        props = scene.basedplayblast\n        \n        # Check if we have a playblast file\n        if not props.last_playblast_file or not os.path.exists(props.last_playblast_file):\n            self.report({'ERROR'}, \"No playblast file found\")\n            return {'CANCELLED'}\n        \n        # Get the file path\n        filepath = props.last_playblast_file\n        \n        # Report which file we're playing\n        self.report",

        "contents": "        \nclass ViewPlayblast(Operator):\n    bl_idname = \"my.playblast_play\"\n    bl_label  = \"View Playblast\"\n    bl_description=\"Play back rendered Playblast using an external player\"\n    bl_options = {'REGISTER', 'UNDO'}\n    \n    def execute(self, context):\n        \n        before_render_filepath    = bpy.context.scene.render.filepath\n        before_use_file_extension = bpy.context.scene.render.use_file_extension\n        before_image_settings_file_format = bpy.context.scene.render.image_settings.file_format\n        before_output_encoding    = bpy.context.scene.render.ffmpeg.format\n        before_audio_codec        = bpy.context.scene.render.ffmpeg.audio_codec\n        \n        \n\n        bpy.context.scene.render.use_file_extension = True  \n        \n        if bpy.types.Scene.saveOutputToFile:\n            bpy.context.scene.render.filepath = bpy.types.Scene.output_file_path\n            if len(bpy.types.Scene.output_file_name) &gt; 0:\n                bpy.context.scene.render.filepath += bpy.types.Scene.output_file_name + \"_\"\n              \n            # Video Settings          \n            if bpy.types.Scene.isVideoFile:\n                bpy.context.scene.render.image_settings.file_format = 'FFMPEG'\n                bpy.context.scene.render.ffmpeg.format = bpy.types.Scene.output_encoding\n            else:\n                bpy.context.scene.render.image_settings.file_format = bpy.types.Scene.image_file_format\n            \n            bpy.context.scene.render.ffmpeg.audio_codec = bpy.types.Scene.audio_codec\n        else:\n            bpy.context.scene.render.filepath = default_file_path\n            bpy.context.scene.render.image_settings.file_format = 'PNG'\n        \n        bpy.ops.render.play_rendered_anim()\n                       \n        bpy.context.scene.render.image_settings.file_format = before_image_settings_file_format\n        bpy.context.scene.render.filepath = before_render_filepath\n        bpy.context.scene.render.use_file_extension = before_use_file_extension\n        bpy.context.scene.render.ffmpeg.format = before_output_encoding",

        "contents": "class BPL_OT_create_playblast(Operator):\n\n    \n    def _register_render_handlers(self):\n        if self._render_handlers_registered:\n            return\n        self._frames_rendered = 0\n        self._last_frame_counted = self._frame_start - 1\n        op_ref = weakref.ref(self)\n        \n        def frame_change_handler(scene):\n            operator = op_ref()\n            if not operator:\n                return\n            frame = scene.frame_current\n            if frame &gt;= operator._frame_start and frame &gt; operator._last_frame_counted:\n                delta = frame - operator._last_frame_counted\n                operator._frames_rendered = min(\n                    operator._frames_rendered + delta,\n                    operator._frame_end - operator._frame_start + 1\n                )\n                operator._last_frame_counted = frame\n        \n        def render_complete_handler(scene):\n            operator = op_ref()\n            if not operator:\n                return\n            operator._render_job_was_running = True\n            operator._render_job_finished_time = time.time()\n        \n        bpy.app.handlers.frame_change_post.append(frame_change_handler)\n        bpy.app.handlers.render_complete.append(render_complete_handler)\n        self._render_handlers_registered = True\n        self._frame_change_handler = frame_change_handler\n        self._render_complete_handler_ref = render_complete_handler\n    \n    def _remove_render_handlers(self):\n        if not self._render_handlers_registered:\n            return\n        if self._frame_change_handler in bpy.app.handlers.frame_change_post:\n            bpy.app.handlers.frame_change_post.remove(self._frame_change_handler)\n        if self._render_complete_handler_ref in bpy.app.handlers.render_complete:\n            bpy.app.handlers.render_complete.remove(self._render_complete_handler_ref)\n        self._render_handlers_registered = False\n        self._frame_change_handler = None\n        self._render_complete_handler_ref = None\n    \n    def modal(self, context, event):\n        if event.type == 'ESC':",

        "contents": "class BPL_OT_create_playblast(Operator):\ndef cleanup(self, context):\n        # Reset progress properties\n\n            # Restore image settings safely using .get() to avoid KeyError\n            try:\n                if isinstance(self._original_settings, dict):\n                    img_settings = self._original_settings.get('image_settings')\n                    if img_settings and isinstance(img_settings, dict):\n                        file_format = img_settings.get('file_format')\n                        if file_format is not None:\n                            scene.render.image_settings.file_format = file_format\n                        color_mode = img_settings.get('color_mode')\n                        if color_mode is not None:\n                            scene.render.image_settings.color_mode = color_mode\n                        # Only restore compression if file format supports it (PNG, JPEG, etc.)\n                        compression = img_settings.get('compression')\n                        if compression is not None:\n                            try:\n                                # Check if compression attribute exists and is settable\n                                if hasattr(scene.render.image_settings, 'compression'):\n                                    scene.render.image_settings.compression = compression\n                            except (AttributeError, TypeError) as comp_error:\n                                print(f\"Warning: Could not restore compression setting: {comp_error}\")\n            except (KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError) as e:\n                print(f\"Warning: Could not restore image settings: {e}\")\n            context.preferences.view.render_display_type = self._original_settings['display_mode']\n            \n            # CRITICAL: Restore frame range to original values - THIS FIXES THE MAIN BUG\n            scene.frame_start = self._original_settings['frame_start']\n            scene.frame_end = self._original_settings['frame_end']\n            \n            # Restore metadata settings\n            scene.render.use_stamp = self._original_settings['use_stamp']\n            scene.render.use_stamp_date = self._original_settings['use_stamp_date']\n            scene.render.use_stamp_time = self._original_settings['use_stamp_time']",

        "contents": "# New operator to apply blast render settings\nclass BPL_OT_apply_blast_settings(Operator):\n    bl_idname = \"bpl.apply_blast_settings\"\n    bl_label = \"Apply Blast Render Settings\"\n    bl_description = \"Apply Playblast render settings to the scene without rendering\"\n    bl_options = {'REGISTER', 'UNDO'}\n    \n    def execute(self, context):\n        # We need os, sys and json in this scope where they're used\n        import os\n        \n        scene = context.scene\n        props = scene.basedplayblast\n        \n        # First, save ALL original settings - always save fresh settings each time\n        # Clear any previously saved settings to ensure we get current state\n        props.original_settings = \"\"\n        props.original_settings_extended = \"\"\n        \n        # TEMPORARY TEST: Set a minimal test setting to verify restore works\n        import json\n        test_settings = {\n            'render_engine': scene.render.engine,\n            'cycles': {\n                'samples': getattr(scene.cycles, 'samples', 128),\n                'use_denoising': getattr(scene.cycles, 'use_denoising', True)\n            }\n        }\n        props.original_settings = json.dumps(test_settings)\n        print(f\"TEMP TEST: Set minimal test settings - engine: {test_settings['render_engine']}, cycles samples: {test_settings['cycles']['samples']}\")\n        \n        import json\n        \n        # COMPREHENSIVE SETTINGS STORAGE - Save EVERYTHING\n        print(f\"Saving comprehensive render settings for engine: {scene.render.engine}\")\n        print(f\"DEBUG: Starting comprehensive settings save process\")\n        \n        def safe_getattr(obj, attr, default=None):\n            \"\"\"Safely get attribute with fallback\"\"\"\n            try:\n                return getattr(obj, attr, default)\n            except:\n                return default\n        \n        def make_json_serializable(obj):\n            \"\"\"Convert object to JSON-serializable format\"\"\"",

        "contents": "class PlayblastSettings(Operator):\ndef execute(self, context):\n = self.extraInfo\n        bpy.types.WindowManager.settings_autoDisableOverlays = self.autoDisableOverlays\n        \n        if self.saveOutputToFile:\n            bpy.types.Scene.output_file_path = self.outputFilePath\n            bpy.types.Scene.output_file_name = self.outputFileName\n        else:\n            bpy.types.Scene.output_file_path = default_file_path\n            bpy.types.Scene.output_file_name = default_file_name\n          \n        bpy.types.Scene.saveOutputToFile   = self.saveOutputToFile\n        \n        if self.outputEncoding != 'IMAGE':\n            bpy.types.Scene.output_encoding = self.outputEncoding\n            bpy.types.Scene.output_quality = self.outputQuality\n            bpy.types.Scene.isVideoFile = True\n        else:\n            bpy.types.Scene.image_file_format = self.imageEncoding\n            bpy.types.Scene.isVideoFile = False\n        \n        bpy.types.Scene.use_stamp_camera   = self.metadata_camera_name \n        bpy.types.Scene.use_stamp_lens     = self.metadata_camera_lens       \n        bpy.types.Scene.use_stamp_scene    = self.metadata_scene_name\n        \n        bpy.types.Scene.audio_codec = self.audioCodec\n        bpy.types.Scene.audio_bitrate = self.audioBitrate\n        bpy.types.Scene.audio_volume = self.audioVolume\n        \n        \n        if self.ColorMode != 'SOLID':\n            bpy.context.space_data.shading.type = self.ColorMode\n        else:\n            bpy.context.space_data.shading.type = self.ColorMode\n            bpy.context.space_data.shading.color_type = self.SolidMode\n\n        \n        return {'FINISHED'}\n\nclass Playblast(Operator):\n    bl_idname = \"my.playblast\"",

        "contents": "# New operator to restore original render settings\nclass BPL_OT_restore_original_settings(Operator):\n    bl_idname = \"bpl.restore_original_settings\"\n    bl_label = \"Restore Original Render Settings\"\n    bl_description = \"Restore the original render settings before the blast settings were applied\"\n    bl_options = {'REGISTER', 'UNDO'}\n    \n    def execute(self, context):\n        scene = context.scene\n        props = scene.basedplayblast\n        \n        # Check if we have original settings saved\n        if not props.original_settings:\n            self.report({'ERROR'}, \"No original settings saved to restore\")\n            return {'CANCELLED'}\n        \n        try:\n            import json\n            import ast  # For evaluating the saved light states\n            original = json.loads(props.original_settings)\n            \n            print(f\"Restoring comprehensive settings for engine: {original.get('render_engine', 'unknown')}\")\n            \n            def safe_restore(obj, attr, value):\n                \"\"\"Safely restore attribute\"\"\"\n                try:\n                    if hasattr(obj, attr):\n                        setattr(obj, attr, value)\n                        return True\n                except Exception as e:\n                    print(f\"Could not restore {attr}: {e}\")\n                    return False\n            \n            # SCENE.RENDER - Restore all basic render settings\n            scene.render.filepath = original['filepath']\n            scene.render.resolution_x = original['resolution_x']\n            scene.render.resolution_y = original['resolution_y']\n            scene.render.resolution_percentage = original['resolution_percentage']\n            safe_restore(scene.render, 'pixel_aspect_x', original.get('pixel_aspect_x', 1.0))\n            safe_restore(scene.render, 'pixel_aspect_y', original.get('pixel_aspect_y', 1.0))\n            scene.render.use_file_extension = original['use_file_extension']\n            scene.render.use_overwrite = original['use_overwrite']\n            scene.render.use_placeholder = original['use_placeholder']",

        "contents": "const JOB_TYPE = {\n},\n        { key: \"png_compression\", type: \"int32\", default: 15, propargs: {min: 0, max: 100}, visible: \"submission\",\n          description: \"PNG compression level (0-100, higher = smaller file)\"},\n        { key: \"keep_frames\", type: \"bool\", default: false, visible: \"submission\",\n          description: \"Keep the individual playblast frames after video creation\"},\n\n        // Automatically evaluated settings:\n        { key: \"blendfile\", type: \"string\", required: true, description: \"Path of the Blend file to playblast\", visible: \"web\" },\n        { key: \"fps\", type: \"float\", eval: \"C.scene.render.fps / C.scene.render.fps_base\", visible: \"hidden\" },\n        { key: \"format\", type: \"string\", required: true, default: \"PNG\", visible: \"web\",\n          description: \"Image format for playblast frames\" },\n        { key: \"image_file_extension\", type: \"string\", required: true, default: \".png\", visible: \"hidden\",\n          description: \"File extension used when creating playblast images\" },\n        { key: \"scene\", type: \"string\", required: true, eval: \"C.scene.name\", visible: \"web\",\n          description: \"Name of the scene to playblast.\"},\n    ]\n};\n\n// File formats that would cause rendering to video.\n// This is not supported by this job type.\nconst videoFormats = ['FFMPEG', 'AVI_RAW', 'AVI_JPEG'];\n\nfunction compileJob(job) {\n    print(\"BasedPlayblast job submitted\");\n}",

        "contents": "const JOB_TYPE = {\n},\n        { key: \"png_compression\", type: \"int32\", default: 15, propargs: {min: 0, max: 100}, visible: \"submission\",\n          description: \"PNG     {
      "codeBlock": {

        "range": {

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 114,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "function compileJob(job) {\n    print(\"BasedPlayblast job submitted\");\n    print(\"job: \", job);\n\n    const settings = job.settings;\n    // Force PNG output and 15% compression regardless of UI selection\n    settings.format = 'PNG';\n    settings.image_file_extension = '.png';\n    if (settings.png_compression === undefined || settings.png_compression === null) {\n        settings.png_compression = 15;\n    }\n    if (videoFormats.indexOf(settings.format) &gt;= 0) {\n        throw &#96;This job type only creates image sequences, and not \"${settings.format}\"&#96;;\n    }\n\n    const playblastOutput = playblastOutputPath(job);\n\n    // Make sure that when the job is investigated later, it shows the\n    // actually-used playblast output:\n    settings.playblast_output_path = playblastOutput;\n\n    // Get the blast base directory (without jobname subfolder)\n    const baseDir = path.dirname(path.dirname(playblastOutput));\n    const playblastDir = path.dirname(playblastOutput);\n    \n    const playblastTasks = authorPlayblastTasks(settings, playblastDir, playblastOutput);\n    const tasks = authorCreateVideoTask(settings, playblastDir, baseDir);\n    \n    // Add all playblast tasks\n    for (const pt of playblastTasks) {\n        job.addTask(pt);\n    }\n    \n    // Add video task and make it dependent on playblast tasks\n    if (tasks &amp;&amp; tasks.length &gt; 0) {\n        const videoTask = tasks[0];\n        // Video task depends on all playblast tasks\n        for (const pt of playblastTasks) {\n            videoTask.addDependency(pt);\n        }\n        job.addTask(videoTask);\n        \n        // If there's a cleanup task, add it too\n        if (tasks.length &gt; 1) {\n            const cleanupTask = tasks[1];\n            job.addTask(cleanupTask);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Do field replacement on the playblast output path.\nfunction playblastOutputPath(job) {\n    let path = job.settings.playblast_output_path;\n}",

        "contents": "function compileJob(job) {\n    print(\"BasedPlayblast OPTIX GPU job submitted\");\n    print(\"job: \", job);\n\n    const settings = job.settings;\n    // Force PNG output and 15% compression regardless of UI selection\n    settings.format = 'PNG';\n    settings.image_file_extension = '.png';\n    if (settings.png_compression === undefined || settings.png_compression === null) {\n        settings.png_compression = 15;\n    }\n    if (videoFormats.indexOf(settings.format) &gt;= 0) {\n        throw &#96;This job type only creates image sequences, and not \"${settings.format}\"&#96;;\n    }\n\n    const playblastOutput = playblastOutputPath(job);\n\n    // Make sure that when the job is investigated later, it shows the\n    // actually-used playblast output:\n    settings.playblast_output_path = playblastOutput;\n\n    // Get the blast base directory (without jobname subfolder)\n    const baseDir = path.dirname(path.dirname(playblastOutput));\n    const playblastDir = path.dirname(playblastOutput);\n    \n    const playblastTasks = authorPlayblastTasks(settings, playblastDir, playblastOutput);\n    const tasks = authorCreateVideoTask(settings, playblastDir, baseDir);\n    \n    // Add all playblast tasks\n    for (const pt of playblastTasks) {\n        job.addTask(pt);\n    }\n    \n    // Add video task and make it dependent on playblast tasks\n    if (tasks &amp;&amp; tasks.length &gt; 0) {\n        const videoTask = tasks[0];\n        // Video task depends on all playblast tasks\n        for (const pt of playblastTasks) {\n            videoTask.addDependency(pt);\n        }\n        job.addTask(videoTask);\n        \n        // If there's a cleanup task, add it too\n        if (tasks.length &gt; 1) {\n            const cleanupTask = tasks[1];\n            job.addTask(cleanupTask);\n        }\n    }\n\n    cleanupJobSettings(job.settings);\n}\n\n// Do field replacement on the playblast output path.\nfunction playblastOutputPath(job) {\n    let path = job.settings.playblast_output_path;\n}",

        "contents": "function compileJob(job) {\n    print(\"BasedPlayblast job submitted\");\n    print(\"job: \", job);\n\n    const settings = job.settings;\n    // Force PNG output and 15% compression regardless of UI selection\n    settings.format = 'PNG';\n    settings.image_file_extension = '.png';\n    if (settings.png_compression === undefined || settings.png_compression === null) {\n        settings.png_compression = 15;\n    }\n    if (videoFormats.indexOf(settings.format) &gt;= 0) {\n        throw &#96;This job type only creates image sequences, and not \"${settings.format}\"&#96;;\n    }\n\n    const playblastOutput = playblastOutputPath(job);\n\n    // Make sure that when the job is investigated later, it shows the\n    // actually-used playblast output:\n    settings.playblast_output_path = playblastOutput;\n\n    // Get the blast base directory (without jobname subfolder)\n    const baseDir = path.dirname(path.dirname(playblastOutput));\n    const playblastDir = path.dirname(playblastOutput);\n    \n    const playblastTasks = authorPlayblastTasks(settings, playblastDir, playblastOutput);\n    const tasks = authorCreateVideoTask(settings, playblastDir, baseDir);\n    \n    // Add all playblast tasks\n    for (const pt of playblastTasks) {\n        job.addTask(pt);\n    }\n    \n    // Add video task and make it dependent on playblast tasks\n    if (tasks &amp;&amp; tasks.length &gt; 0) {\n        const videoTask = tasks[0];\n        // Video task depends on all playblast tasks\n        for (const pt of playblastTasks) {\n            videoTask.addDependency(pt);\n        }\n        job.addTask(videoTask);\n        \n        // If there's a cleanup task, add it too\n        if (tasks.length &gt; 1) {\n            const cleanupTask = tasks[1];\n            job.addTask(cleanupTask);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Do field replacement on the playblast output path.\nfunction playblastOutputPath(job) {\n    let path = job.settings.playblast_output_path;\n}",

        "contents": "# -- Render IO -------------------------------------------------------------\ndef set_video_file_format(scene) -&gt; bool:\n    \"\"\"\n    Force Blender onto a video-friendly output. Returns True if a usable\n    format was chosen; False means callers should warn/abort.\n    \n    - Blender 4.2/4.5: Can set FFMPEG directly for direct video output\n    - Blender 5.0+: image_settings.file_format no longer includes video formats.\n      We use PNG with 0% compression (fast, lossless) and encode frames manually.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not scene or not getattr(scene, \"render\", None):\n        return False\n\n    render = scene.render\n    is_blender_5 = version.is_version_at_least(5, 0, 0)\n\n    if not is_blender_5:\n        # Blender 4.2/4.5: Can set FFMPEG directly for direct video output\n        try:\n            render.image_settings.file_format = \"FFMPEG\"\n            return True\n        except Exception as exc:\n            print(f\"[BasedPlayblast] FFMPEG set failed: {exc}\")\n            return False\n\n    # Blender 5.0+: image_settings.file_format only supports image formats\n    # Use PNG with 0% compression - fast writes, lossless quality, then encode to video\n    if hasattr(render, \"ffmpeg\"):\n        try:\n            render.image_settings.file_format = \"PNG\"\n            render.image_settings.compression = 0  # 0% compression = fastest PNG writes\n            print(\"[BasedPlayblast] Blender 5.0: Using PNG with 0% compression \"\n                  \"(fast, lossless quality). Blender 5.0 removed video formats from \"\n                  \"image_settings.file_format, so we encode frames to video manually.\")\n            return True\n        except Exception as exc:\n            print(f\"[BasedPlayblast] PNG with 0% compression failed: {exc}\")\n    \n    # Last resort: PNG with default compression\n    try:\n        render.image_settings.file_format = \"PNG\"\n        print(\"[BasedPlayblast] video fallback -&gt; PNG sequence (will encode manually)\")\n        return False\n    except Exception as exc:\n        print(f\"[BasedPlayblast] PNG fallback failed: {exc}\")\n        return False\n\n\ndef viewport_opengl_render(context, area=None, region=None):\n    \"\"\"",

        "contents": "function authorPlayblastTasks(settings, playblastDir, playblastOutput) {\n\n    }\n\n    let baseArgs = [];\n    if (settings.scene) {\n        baseArgs = baseArgs.concat([\"--scene\", settings.scene]);\n    }\n\n    for (let chunk of chunks) {\n        const task = author.Task(&#96;playblast-${chunk}&#96;, \"blender\");\n        \n        // Use standard rendering with the blend file's existing settings\n        const renderCommand = author.Command(\"blender-render\", {\n            exe: \"{blender}\",\n            exeArgs: \"{blenderArgs}\",\n            argsBefore: blender_args_before,\n            blendfile: settings.blendfile,\n            args: baseArgs.concat(task_invariant_args).concat([\n                '--python-expr',\n                &#96;import bpy; bpy.context.scene.render.image_settings.compression = ${settings.png_compression}; bpy.context.scene.render.resolution_percentage = ${settings.resolution_percentage}&#96;,\n                '--render-frame',\n                chunk.replaceAll(\"-\", \"..\") // Convert to Blender frame range notation.\n            ])\n        });\n        \n        task.addCommand(renderCommand);\n        playblastTasks.push(task);\n    }\n    return playblastTasks;\n}\n\nfunction authorCreateVideoTask(settings, playblastDir, baseDir) {\n    if\n}",

        "contents": "class BPLProperties(PropertyGroup):\n\n    \n    use_scene_frame_range: BoolProperty(  # type: ignore\n        name=\"Use Scene Frame Range\",\n        description=\"Use the scene's frame range for the playblast\",\n        default=True\n    )\n    \n    start_frame: IntProperty(  # type: ignore\n        name=\"Start Frame\",\n        description=\"First frame to playblast\",\n        default=1\n    )\n    \n    end_frame: IntProperty(  # type: ignore\n        name=\"End Frame\",\n        description=\"Last frame to playblast\",\n        default=250\n    )\n    \n    file_format: EnumProperty(  # type: ignore\n        name=\"File Format\",\n        description=\"Format to save the playblast\",\n        items=FILE_FORMAT_ITEMS,\n        default='VIDEO'\n    )\n    \n    video_format: EnumProperty(  # type: ignore\n        name=\"Video Format\",\n        description=\"Format for video file\",\n        items=VIDEO_FORMAT_ITEMS,\n        default='MPEG4'\n    )\n    \n    video_codec: EnumProperty(  # type: ignore\n        name=\"Video Codec\",\n        description=\"Codec for video file\",\n        items=VIDEO_CODEC_ITEMS,\n        default='H264'\n    )\n    \n    video_quality: EnumProperty(  # type: ignore\n        name=\"Quality\",\n        description=\"Quality of the video\",\n        items=VIDEO_QUALITY_ITEMS,\n        default='MEDIUM'\n    )\n    \n    include_audio: BoolProperty(  # type: ignore\n        name=\"Include Audio\",\n        description=\"Include audio in the playblast\",\n        default=False\n    )\n    \n    audio_codec: EnumProperty(  # type: ignore\n        name=\"Audio Codec\",\n        description=\"Codec for audio\",\n        items=AUDIO_CODEC_ITEMS,\n        default='AAC'\n    )\n    \n    audio_bitrate: IntProperty(  # type: ignore\n        name=\"Audio Bitrate\",\n        description=\"Bitrate for audio (kb/s)\",\n        default=192,\n        min=32,\n        max=384\n    )\n    \n    display_mode:",

        "contents": "class BPL_OT_sync_file_name(Operator):\ndef execute(self, context):\n not file_name:\n            file_name = \"blast_\"\n        else:\n            # Add the blast_ prefix if it's not already there\n            if not file_name.startswith(\"blast_\"):\n                file_name = \"blast_\" + file_name\n        \n        # Set the BasedPlayblast file name\n        scene.basedplayblast.file_name = file_name\n        \n        # Clear the last playblast file paths since we're changing the filename\n        scene.basedplayblast.last_playblast_file = \"\"\n        \n        self.report({'INFO'}, f\"File name synced with Blender's output file name\")\n        return {'FINISHED'}\n\n# New operator to apply user defaults\nclass BPL_OT_apply_user_defaults(Operator):\n    bl_idname = \"bpl.apply_user_defaults\"\n    bl_label = \"Apply User Defaults\"\n    bl_description = \"Apply the user's default settings from Add-on Preferences to the current scene\"\n    bl_options = {'REGISTER', 'UNDO'}\n\n    def execute(self, context):\n        prefs = context.preferences.addons[__name__].preferences\n        props = context.scene.basedplayblast\n\n        props.video_quality = prefs.default_video_quality\n        props.use_custom_ffmpeg_args = prefs.default_use_custom_ffmpeg_args\n        props.custom_ffmpeg_args = prefs.default_ffmpeg_args\n\n        self.report({'INFO'}, \"User defaults applied to scene.\")\n        return {'FINISHED'}\n\n# New operator to apply blast render settings\nclass BPL_OT_apply_blast_settings(Operator):\n    bl_idname = \"bpl.apply_blast_settings\"\n    bl_label = \"Apply Blast Render Settings\"\n    bl_description = \"Apply Playblast render settings to the scene without rendering\"\n    bl_options = {'REGISTER', 'UNDO'}\n    \n    def execute(self, context):\n        # We need os, sys and json in this scope where they're used\n        import os\n        \n        scene = context.scene\n        props = scene.basedplayblast",

        "contents": "// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later\n\nconst JOB_TYPE = {\n    label: \"BasedPlayblast OPTIX GPU\",\n    description: \"Create a viewport preview/playblast using Cycles OPTIX GPU rendering and generate a video file\",\n    settings: [\n        // Settings for artists to determine:\n        { key: \"frames\", type: \"string\", required: true,\n          eval: \"f'{C.scene.frame_start}-{C.scene.frame_end}'\",\n          evalInfo: {\n            showLinkButton: true,\n            description: \"Scene frame range\",\n          },\n          description: \"Frame range to playblast. Examples: '47', '1-30', '3, 5-10, 47-327'\" },\n        { key: \"chunk_size\", type: \"int32\", default: 5, description: \"Number of frames to playblast in one Blender task\",\n          visible: \"submission\" },\n\n        // playblast_output_root + add_path_components determine the value of playblast_output_path.\n        { key: \"playblast_output_root\", type: \"string\", subtype: \"dir_path\", required: true, default: \"//\", visible: \"submission\",\n          description: \"Base directory of where playblast output is stored. Will have some job-specific parts appended to it\"},\n        { key: \"add_path_components\", type: \"int32\", required: true, default: 0, propargs: {min: 0, max: 32}, visible: \"submission\",\n          description: \"Number of path components of the current blend file to use in the playblast output path\"},\n        { key: \"playblast_output_path\", type: \"string\", subtype: \"file_path\", editable: false,\n          eval: \"str(Path(abspath(settings.playblast_output_root), last_n_dir_parts(settings.add_path_components), 'blast', jobname, jobname + '_######'))\",\n          description: \"Final file path of where playblast output will be saved\"},\n          \n        // Playblast specific settings\n        { key: \"resolution_percentage\", type: \"int32\", default: 100, propargs: {min: 1, max: 100}, visible: \"submission\",\n          description: \"Percentage of the render resolution to use for playblast\"},\n        { key: \"png_compression\", type: \"int32\", default: 15, propargs: {min: 0, max: 100}, visible: \"submission\",\n          description: \"PNG compression level (0-100, higher = smaller file)\"}\n};",

        "contents": "class BPL_OT_create_playblast(Operator):\ndef invoke(self, context, event):\n\n                        \n                        # Store original render settings to restore later\n                        if not hasattr(self, '_original_cycles_render'):\n                            self._original_cycles_render = {\n                                'samples': getattr(cycles, 'samples', 128),\n                                'use_denoising': getattr(cycles, 'use_denoising', True),\n                                'max_bounces': getattr(cycles, 'max_bounces', 12),\n                                'diffuse_bounces': getattr(cycles, 'diffuse_bounces', 4),\n                                'glossy_bounces': getattr(cycles, 'glossy_bounces', 4),\n                                'transmission_bounces': getattr(cycles, 'transmission_bounces', 12),\n                                'volume_bounces': getattr(cycles, 'volume_bounces', 0),\n                                'use_adaptive_sampling': getattr(cycles, 'use_adaptive_sampling', True),\n                                'adaptive_threshold': getattr(cycles, 'adaptive_threshold', 0.01),\n                            }\n                        \n                        # Apply ultra-fast settings for playblast\n                        if hasattr(cycles, 'samples'):\n                            cycles.samples = 8  # Very low for speed\n                        if hasattr(cycles, 'use_denoising'):\n                            cycles.use_denoising = False  # Disable for speed\n                        if hasattr(cycles, 'max_bounces'):\n                            cycles.max_bounces = 2  # Minimal bounces\n                        if hasattr(cycles, 'diffuse_bounces'):\n                            cycles.diffuse_bounces = 1\n                        if hasattr(cycles, 'glossy_bounces'):\n                            cycles.glossy_bounces = 1\n                        if hasattr(cycles, 'transmission_bounces'):\n                            cycles.transmission_bounces = 1\n                        if hasattr(cycles, 'volume_bounces'):\n                            cycles.volume_bounces = 0",

        "contents": "class Playblast(Operator):\ndef playblast(self):               \n\n        \n        if bpy.types.Scene.saveOutputToFile:       \n                     \n           if bpy.types.Scene.isVideoFile:\n               bpy.context.scene.render.image_settings.file_format = 'FFMPEG'\n               bpy.context.scene.render.ffmpeg.format = bpy.types.Scene.output_encoding\n               bpy.context.scene.render.ffmpeg.codec = bpy.types.Scene.ffmpeg_codec\n               bpy.context.scene.render.ffmpeg.constant_rate_factor = bpy.types.Scene.output_quality\n               bpy.context.scene.render.ffmpeg.ffmpeg_preset = bpy.types.Scene.ffmpeg_preset     \n           else:\n               bpy.context.scene.render.image_settings.file_format = bpy.types.Scene.image_file_format\n  \n          \n           bpy.context.scene.render.ffmpeg.audio_codec = bpy.types.Scene.audio_codec\n           bpy.context.scene.render.ffmpeg.audio_bitrate = bpy.types.Scene.audio_bitrate\n           bpy.context.scene.render.ffmpeg.audio_volume = bpy.types.Scene.audio_volume\n        else:\n           bpy.context.scene.render.filepath = default_file_path\n           bpy.context.scene.render.image_settings.file_format = 'PNG'\n        \n        \n        bpy.context.scene.render.use_stamp_date = True\n        bpy.context.scene.render.use_stamp_time = True\n        bpy.context.scene.render.use_stamp_frame = True\n        bpy.context.scene.render.use_stamp_camera = bpy.types.Scene.use_stamp_camera\n        bpy.context.scene.render.use_stamp_lens = bpy.types.Scene.use_stamp_lens\n        bpy.context.scene.render.use_stamp_scene = bpy.types.Scene.use_stamp_scene\n        \n        bpy.context.scene.render.use_stamp_note = True\n        \n        note = \"Playblast\"\n        note += \", Blender Version: \" + bpy.app.version_string\n\n        if bpy.types.WindowManager.settings_displayResolution:",

        "contents": "function authorCreateVideoTask(settings, playblastDir, baseDir) {\n    if (!settings.fps) {\n        print(\"Not authoring video task, no FPS known:\", settings);\n        return;\n    }\n\n    var frames = &#96;${settings.frames}&#96;;\n    if (frames.search(',') != -1) {\n        // Get the first and last frame from the list\n        const chunks = frameChunker(settings.frames, 1);\n        const firstFrame = chunks[0];\n        const lastFrame = chunks.slice(-1)[0];\n        frames = &#96;${firstFrame}-${lastFrame}&#96;;\n    }\n\n    const jobname = path.stem(path.basename(playblastDir));\n    // Create video output path directly in the blast folder with the naming convention blast_[jobname]_[frames].mp4\n    const outfile = path.join(baseDir, &#96;blast_${jobname}_${frames}.mp4&#96;);\n    const inputGlob = path.join(playblastDir, &#96;*${settings.image_file_extension}&#96;);\n\n    // Create the ffmpeg task\n    const videoTask = author.Task('playblast-video', 'ffmpeg');\n    \n    // Command to create the video from frames\n    const ffmpegCommand = author.Command(\"frames-to-video\", {\n        exe: \"ffmpeg\",\n        fps: settings.fps,\n        inputGlob: inputGlob,\n        outputFile: outfile,\n        args: [\n            '-c:v',\n            'h264_nvenc',\n            '-preset',\n            'medium',\n            '-rc',\n            'constqp',\n            '-qp',\n            '20',\n            '-g',\n            '18',\n            '-vf',\n            'pad=ceil(iw/2)*2:ceil(ih/2)*2',\n            '-pix_fmt',\n            'yuv420p',\n            '-r',\n            settings.fps,\n            '-y', // Be sure to always pass either \"-n\" or \"-y\".\n        ],\n    });\n    \n    videoTask.addCommand(ffmpegCommand);\n    \n    // Only create cleanup task if keep_frames is false\n}",
